datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
select rownum, p.id,p.numberofcredit,b.boorowerid,b.name,v.val_name,b.guarantorsalary,b.guarantorname,p.creditlineamount,h.rest+h.duerest rest,h.interestrest,
 (select description from cm_usergroups where id=usrgroup) exp from smart.cm_active_credits p,CM_BOOROWERINFO b,smart.avalute_t v,cm_curr_state h
where p.id=b.creditid and p.id=h.creditid and
p.currency=v.valute --and rownum=1


order by rownum

datasets.name: OracleDataSet2
datasets.sql:
select rownum,p.id, p.numberofcredit,b.boorowerid,b.name,v.val_name,b.guarantorsalary,b.guarantorname,h.rest as creditlineamount,
b.guarantorname2,b.guarantorsalary2,p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,b.phonenumber,b.salary,b.zaminwork1,
b.zamintel1
 from smart.cm_active_credits p,CM_BOOROWERINFO b,smart.avalute_t v,cm_history h
where p.id=b.creditid and h.creditid=p.id and h.hdate =(select tek_dat from smart.sysdat) and
p.currency=v.valute 
and p.id=:pid

datasets.sql: select rownum, B.* from smart.CM_ZaminID B where B.boorowerid is not null
